---
title: "System control and upkeep"
subtitle: "Section 3"
---

Keep a growing research workspace understandable, controlled, and reproducible.

## Learning goal

Demonstrate startup and closeout routines, resolve or escalate a backlog item, and verify a retention plan.

## Slides

- [System control and upkeep](../slides/upkeep.qmd)

These decks are working teaching drafts. Slide text is available in the editable Quarto source.

## Main topics

- Work gates, continuity, and safe handoffs
- Issue triage, human decisions, and verified repairs
- Regeneration checks, retention, and measured improvements

## Practice

Submit a maintenance record with startup/closeout, one justified change or decision to retain the system, relevant verification, and a cleanup plan. Demonstrate cleanup on disposable material or through simulation.

Exercise details are proposals for instructor review. The final rubric and submission arrangements will accompany the teaching release.
